findings.line: 7799 mm² flat print-down face at z=51.150 · 211.0 × 163.7 mm · open to the bed (51.2 mm up)
findings.reason: The 5 mm clamping flange provides the bare closing land and room for M4 washers and clamps. Its 16 mm margin surrounds the silicone brim on both axes. The 2026-10-05 native Snug slice records bed-rooted interface-5 at print Z50.602–50.880 beneath this band. Cut and detach support at the exposed outer edges before finishing.

findings.line: 963 mm² flat print-down face at z=44.840 · 179.0 × 131.7 mm · open to the bed (44.8 mm up)
findings.reason: This underside backs the silicone brim with at least 5 mm shell stock. The 2026-10-05 native Snug slice records bed-rooted interface-4 at print Z44.362–45.600 in the brim band. Cut and detach support through the open dry back before finishing the forming face.

findings.line: 1266 mm² flat print-down face at z=1.890 · 41.0 × 36.0 mm · open to the bed (1.9 mm up)
findings.reason: This flat underside backs the silicone block with 5 mm shell stock. The 2026-10-05 native Snug slice records bed-rooted interface-2 at print Z1.440–2.640 in the block band. Cut and detach support from the open underside between the three mold feet.

findings.line: 211 mm² flat print-down face at z=0.700 · 16.4 × 16.4 mm · open to the bed (0.7 mm up)
findings.reason: This is the dry underside of the lower rod socket. Its 5 mm floor stops the steel rod below the silicone block; it sits 0.7 mm above the feet datum. The 2026-10-05 native Snug slice records bed-rooted interface-1 at print Z0.200–0.480 beneath it. Cut and detach support through the open underside before fitting the rod.

These four vertical faces are the 0.30 mm edge of the finishing pocket over the silicone brim. The 4.70 mm flange behind the pocket supports its forming face; the thin strip is a surface-level change. Keep the surrounding lands bare.

findings.line: 179 mm² flat print-down face at z=26.465 · 16.4 × 16.4 mm · open to the bed (34.7 mm up)
findings.reason: This annulus is the top of the straight rod guide: 16.4 mm outside diameter and an open 6.4 mm passage. Its surrounding 5 mm radial stock holds the 7.7 mm guide bearing. With the core inverted, the annulus lies at print Z34.685 within the 2026-10-05 bed-rooted Snug interface-1 region (print Z22.040–35.280). Cut and detach support through the open dry back and clear the passage before dropping in the steel rod.

findings.line: Δ0.300 mm between parallel planes · footprint met 179.6 × 132.3 mm
findings.reason: The forming pocket over the silicone brim reserves 0.30 mm of coating growth. The surrounding bare lands set closure height. This face prints upward with the core inverted; the 4.70 mm stock behind it supports the forming face.
